STARCRAFTING.Title: The Starforge
STARCRAFTING.ChooseCrafterHint: Whose crafting log should the Starforge open?
STARCRAFTING.NoCrafter: You need a character to use the Starforge. Ask your GM to assign one, or select your token first.

Log.Title: Crafting Log
Log.Empty: Nothing on the anvil yet. Drop an unenchanted starsteel item into the forge to begin.

Summary.Fresh: Cast a prepared spell from your spellbook to begin the infusion.
Summary.Complete: Every spell is fully infused. Your GM will tell you what the item can now do.

Forge.Drop: Drop an unenchanted starsteel item here
Forge.DropHintKeyword: Drag an item whose name contains "{keyword}" from your character's inventory.
Forge.DropHintAny: Drag any item from your character's inventory.
Forge.OrChoose: …or choose an item from your crafting log.
Forge.Remove: Take this item out of the crafting log
Forge.Close: Put the item back in the log
Forge.Added: {item} has been placed in the Starforge.
Forge.Removed: {item} has been taken out of the crafting log.

Etching.Title: Runic Etching

none.Name: No Etching
none.Hint: The starsteel is left bare. Every cast counts once, plus extra for higher-level slots.

School.Name: {school} Etching
School.Hint: {school} spells cast into this item count double when infusing.

mastercrafted.Name: Mastercrafted
mastercrafted.Hint: Masterwork runes let two different spells be infused into this item, each with its own progress.

Etching.Superior: Etched items may have superior effects when fully infused.
Etching.OneOnly: An item can bear only one etching. You can change it until the first spell is cast into the item.
Etching.Locked: The etching is set: it can't change once a spell has been cast into the item.
Etching.LockedNote: The runes are set. Only the GM can change this etching now.
Etching.GMOverride: GM override: the etching can be changed even though casts have been made.

Slot.Title: Infusion
Slot.EmptyHint: Cast a spell from your spellbook, or drag one here, to bind it.
Slot.Doubled: Doubled: this spell matches the item's {etching}

Spellbook.Title: Spellbook
Spellbook.Empty: No prepared spells of 1st level or higher. Prepare spells on your character sheet to infuse them.
Spellbook.SelectFirst: Choose an item in the forge to infuse your spells into it.
Spellbook.NoSlotsLeft: No slots left that can cast this spell.
Spellbook.PillTooltip: Spend a {ordinal}-level slot ({value} of {max} left): +{gain} progress
Spellbook.PactPillTooltip: Spend a pact slot ({ordinal} level, {value} of {max} left): +{gain} progress
Spellbook.Overflow: Only {gained} more needed to finish; the rest is lost.

Reason.slotsOccupied: This item's sockets are bound to other spells.
Reason.slotComplete: This spell is already fully infused here.

Spellbook.ConfirmContent: Spend a {slot} slot to cast {spell} into the {item} (+{gain} progress)?

Chronicle.Title: Chronicle
Chronicle.EntryPact: {who} cast {spell} with a pact slot ({slot} level) (+{value})
Chronicle.Truncated: Showing the {shown} most recent of {total} casts.

Chat.CastLine: {actor} channels {spell} into the starsteel using a {slot} slot.
Chat.CastLinePact: {actor} channels {spell} into the starsteel using a pact slot ({slot} level).

GM.Title: GM
GM.EditHint: Set how many casts each socket holds. Setting a socket to its full amount completes it.
GM.RemoveContent: Remove {item} from the crafting log? Its infusion progress will be erased and the item will count as unenchanted again.
GM.UnbindContent: Unbind {spell} and erase its {progress} casts of progress?

Error.etchingLocked: The etching can't be changed once a spell has been cast into the item.
Error.cantripOrInvalid: Only spells of 1st level or higher can be infused.
Error.alreadyBound: {spell} is already bound to this item's other socket.
Error.slotsOccupied: This item's sockets are bound to other spells.
Error.slotComplete: That spell is already fully infused into this item.
Error.itemComplete: This item is already fully infused.
Error.slotTooLow: That slot is too low; the spell needs a slot of level {level} or higher.
Error.noSlotLeft: You have no slots of that level left.
Error.notOwned: Only items from {actor}'s own inventory can go into their Starforge.
Error.notPhysical: Only physical items (weapons, armour, gear and so on) can be infused.
Error.notStarsteel: {item} isn't starsteel. Only items whose name contains "{keyword}" can be infused.
Error.notUnenchanted: {item} is already enchanted (it has the Magical property). Only unenchanted starsteel can be infused.
Error.notSpell: Only spells can be dropped into a socket.
Error.spellNeedsSocket: Drop spells onto one of the item's infusion sockets.
Error.notYourSpell: You can only infuse spells from {actor}'s own spellbook.
Error.noItemSelected: Choose an item in the forge first.
Error.noPermission: You don't have permission to change this item.
Error.busy: Hold on: the last cast is still settling into the starsteel.
Error.gmOnly: Only the GM can do that.

Keyword.Name: Starsteel keyword
Keyword.Hint: An item counts as starsteel when its name contains this word (not case-sensitive).

RequireKeyword.Name: Only starsteel items
RequireKeyword.Hint: When on, only items whose name contains the keyword can be placed in the Starforge. Turn off to allow any physical item.

RequireMundane.Name: Only unenchanted items
RequireMundane.Hint: When on, items with dnd5e's Magical property can't be placed in the Starforge. Turn off if your starsteel is magical by nature.

CastChat.Name: Chat card for each cast
CastChat.Hint: Who sees the chat card posted each time a spell is cast into an item.

CompleteChat.Name: Chat card when an item is complete
CompleteChat.Hint: Who sees the announcement when an item becomes fully infused.

ConfirmCast.Name: Confirm before spending a slot
ConfirmCast.Hint: Ask before each cast in the Starforge spends a spell slot.
